label: Agency site: sharpen the services grid and add the missing third service
instruction: Our services grid is thin. Make each card say something concrete, tighten the layout, and add a third card for the implementation work we do.

response.summary: Sharpened both service cards, ruled the grid, and added the implementation service that was missing.

actions.reason: Ruled cards with wide gutters match the studio identity and separate three services cleanly.

changes.title: Brand systems
changes.description: Naming, identity, type and colour delivered as a documented system rather than a folder of finished artwork.

actions.reason: Names the deliverable instead of the category, and points at the page that explains the engagement.

changes.title: Product design
changes.description: Interface work built on the same tokens as the brand, so the marketing site and the product stop diverging.

actions.reason: Explains the connection to the brand system, which is what distinguishes this from generic UI work.

attributes.title: Implementation
attributes.description: We hand over running code: design tokens, a component library and documentation your engineers will actually read.

actions.reason: The third service was missing from the grid entirely.
